ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a link target for this section. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Required. The main heading for this section. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.
SectionTitle.placeholder: Make the next step feel easy.

SectionDescription.helper: Required. Briefly explain the offer or next step. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Help visitors understand the value and what they can do next.

SectionImage.helper: Required. Uploads go to Content/Hero/. Use a clear landscape image at least 1200 pixels wide. Keep important details near the center because the image may crop on smaller screens.

SectionImageAlt.helper: Optional but recommended. Describe the image for visitors using screen readers. Leave blank only when the image is decorative.
SectionImageAlt.placeholder: A customer completing a simple online purchase

PrimaryCTAText.helper: Optional. Add this together with a Primary CTA URL to show the main button. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.

PrimaryCTAURL.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https URL. The button appears only when both text and a valid URL are provided.

PrimaryCTAIcon.helper: Optional. Find icons at FontAwesome. Example: fas fa-building

SecondaryCTAText.helper: Optional. Add this together with a Secondary CTA URL to show a second button. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.

SecondaryCTAURL.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https URL. The button appears only when both text and a valid URL are provided.

SecondaryCTAIcon.helper: Optional. Find icons at FontAwesome. Example: fas fa-building

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. Add a short note below the buttons. HTML is allowed and will render in the view.
SectionFooter.placeholder: No obligation. Choose a time that works for you.
